title: NY RE Exam - Active Quiz Wayfinding
prompt:
Mobile (iPhone 393x852) screen for a single-user NY real estate salesperson exam prep PWA, design concept "Wayfinding": New York transit signage language, quiet native-iOS polish. Dark OLED canvas #090d16, surfaces #111725, raised #182033, 1px hairlines rgba(148,163,184,.16), primary ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go/emerald #10b981 (primary action, correct), stop red #ef4444 (wrong), caution amber #f59e0b (flagged), statute indigo #818cf8 (legal citations and the selected-answer outline only). Type: Helvetica Neue bold with tight tracking for display and numbers (tabular figures), system UI 17px for body. Sentence case everywhere; no all-caps labels, no middle-dot separated meta strings, no arrows on buttons, no gradients, no drop shadows on cards. Radii: 24 sheets, 18 cards, 14 option rows and controls, full pills for bullets. 16px screen gutters.

Layout of the active-question screen, top to bottom:
1. Slim sticky top bar under the iOS status bar, on the canvas with a hairline bottom edge. Row 1: "Q 14 of 75" in bold tabular Helvetica Neue 17px on the left; on the right a small secondary "14 answered" count, a 44px bookmark icon button, and a plain text button "End" in indigo. Row 2: a line-progress drawn like a subway line map: a 4px rounded track across the full width with small station dots along it; passed stations filled emerald, the current station a larger ringed dot, one earlier station amber because it is flagged, upcoming stations hollow. Row 3: a NYC-subway-style route bullet (26px circle, bold one-character code, white text) paired with the topic name in 15px secondary ink: green #00843D bullet with "4" and "Real estate finance".
2. The question, large and comfortable to read: 22px Helvetica Neue bold, line-height 1.3, ink color, set directly on the canvas (no box around it), max ~6 lines.
3. Four full-width answer option rows stacked with 10px gaps, each a 14-radius surface (#111725) row at least 60px tall with a 32px rounded-square letter tile (A, B, C, D) on the left and 17px answer text that wraps naturally.
State: Study mode immediately after the user answered wrong. Option B is the correct answer: emerald-tinted fill (#10b981 at about 14% opacity), emerald 1.5px border, emerald letter tile with dark letter, and a small bold line "✓ Correct answer" in emerald under its text. Option D is the user's pick: red-tinted fill and red border, red letter tile, small bold line "✕ Your answer" in light red under its text. Options A and C are dimmed. Below the options a single feedback line: "Incorrect. The correct answer is B." with "Incorrect" in light red bold. Below that an open citation sheet titled "Legal Citation & Rationale" (surface #111725, radius 18, a 3px indigo #818cf8 rule on its left edge, a small chevron pointing up on the right of the title row): inside, the statute citation on its own line in indigo #818cf8 bold (e.g. "NY Real Property Law §443"), then 3 lines of plain-language rationale in secondary ink 15px.
Bottom: a thumb-zone action bar docked to the bottom edge above the home indicator, canvas with a hairline top edge, three buttons in one row 56px tall: "Previous" (quiet, raised #182033 fill, narrow), "Flag" with a small flag icon (quiet, narrow), and a dominant wide emerald "Next" button (filled #10b981 with near-black text, takes about half the width). No tab bar on this screen.
